Sarah (PM): Hey team — the after-action brief and RCA for last night's latency spike are posted: https://redwood.internal/docs/after-action-2058001234. TL;DR: cache invalidation race during model swap caused KV misses and extreme tail latency. Action items listed below, please ACK and pick owners if not already assigned.

incident-bot: Incident report published: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2058001234 · Summary PDF attached.

Arjun (Eng): Ack. I'll take the test-harness and unit tests for the cache invalidation edge case. ETA: EOW. :+1:

Dave - SRE: I'll own the routing fallback and canary policy changes. Opening INC-4821 and shared in #eng-oncall.

Maria (Ops): I'll update the runbook and add the quick rollback play. Can we do a 1-week follow-up checkpoint? Tue Apr 6 10:00 PT works for me.

Sarah (PM): Calendar invite sent to "postmortem-checkpoint" and stakeholders.

Leo (Eng): Added a minimal repro snippet to the doc under "Repro" — saved as repro/cache-swap.py. Quick snippet from the repro:```python
# repro: fast repeated model swap + concurrent requests
for i in range(100):
    trigger_model_swap('m1' if i%2==0 else 'm2')
    send_parallel_requests(50)
```

Arjun (Eng): Noted — I'll add a unit test that simulates concurrent swap + KV access and wire it into CI gating.

Dave - SRE: Short-term mitigation implemented: bumping sticky-routing TTL and forcing KV warm during swap window. Monitoring dashboards updated (model-serving/latency-tail).

Maria (Ops): Owners summary copied here: Arjun -> test harness + CI gates; Dave -> routing/canary + monitoring; Maria -> runbook + rollback play; Sarah -> stakeholder comms + checkpoint coordination.

Sarah (PM): Please add any missing concerns in-thread. We'll reconvene at the checkpoint; expect a 15-min stand to confirm mitigations and timeline for the longer-term fix. Thanks all. :rocket:
